requiredBehaviors.behavior: define the first-beta scope independently from the full roadmap
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Beta-Scope section requires a one-sentence first-beta definition centered on the intended user and primary path rather than the whole roadmap.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: score only evidenced beta-scope capabilities across the six dimensions
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Beta-Gate defines six weighted dimensions and explicitly says to award points only for evidenced capabilities in the first-beta scope.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: declare beta reached at 100 percent without penalizing explicitly post-beta features
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The percentage and Beta-Status sections state that post-beta roadmap features do not reduce readiness and beta is reached at 100 points with no hard blocker.
The Beta-Runbook section requires beta-runbook.md whenever beta reaches 100 percent.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat the full product roadmap as the beta denominator
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly excludes later roadmap work from the readiness denominator.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: aggregate unrelated repositories into the same assessment
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The purpose and boundary section mandates exactly one repository per execution and aggregation only after repeated per-project runs.
